title: About me
body:
Why MageTech?

One of my first email addresses was randomly assigned as MagE01@****.com

Also, being a bit of sci-fi nerd I remembered the Arthur C. Clarke quote ,"Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic"...I may have been a bit full of myself in the early years.

I never developed a portfolio or Git repo because I've been too busy writing code that makes money for companies. This updated website is an effort to change that, it was built with AI. Read the next post to learn more!

title: Built with AI
body:
Am I a good developer because I am lazy? Maybe. I’ve stayed gainfully employed through a couple of recessions so that says something I guess.

But I admit I have been feeling the heat from the AI revolution. So this website is an experiment in being as vibe codey as possible. I’ve been using Junie from IntelliJ and chatGPT (Cat, I farted for you French speakers).

I’ve posted the code at a Git repo.

title: The job interview
body:
I've done a low-tech screen recording of a personal code review of the current state of the project.

This will give you an idea of my thought process and how I conduct myself in an interview.

If you are looking for someone who can calculate a Fibonacci sequence using recursive calls during a job interview without the use of StackOverflow/Google/AI, I'm not your developer.

If you are looking for an experienced, thoughtful developer who is capable of getting stuff done in short order, please say hello. :)

title: HIPAA compliant chatbot in 8 hours....sorta
body:
Here is a chatbot that I built in 8 hours using AI. It tries to be HIPAA compliant.

It uses Telegram bot for a secure channel. On my local machine, the text file is encrypted as is my hard-drive. So the spirit is there.

NestJS is the backend. It handles appending messages to an encrypted file.

It is meant as an answering service for a therapist. It is not meant to provide treatment but to provide a high-level summary of a client's messages sent to bot.

For this POC, I used an Ollama local server using llama3.2. Here's a git repo with more details: https://github.com/emaggini-1/nestjs-telegram-bot.git

title: It's amazing how fast things change
body:
6 months ago the IDE tools were slow and clunky. Now thanks to the windsurf plugin for JetBrains, I am able to code at an entirely new level.

These tools are certainly bad for CS101 students just starting out but once you can tell the difference between bad code and good code, it really is revolutionary.

Workflows allow for creation of MCP-style enhancements to your IDE.

title: AI Coding Evolution: 6 Months Later
body:
Six months have passed since my last post about AI coding tools, and the pace of change has been nothing short of remarkable. What was revolutionary then is now table stakes, and the bar keeps rising.

Discoveries from Band Fan Site Development

I've been developing a band fan site with NFT claiming functionality, and AI tools have been instrumental throughout. Here are some key discoveries:

1. Dependency Compatibility Issues

The project ran into Angular 21 compatibility issues with @heavy-duty/wallet-adapter. AI tools helped me quickly identify the problem and pivot to using @solana/wallet-adapter-phantom directly with a custom WalletService using Angular signals. This saved hours of debugging and research.

2. Comprehensive Code Reviews

I ran an AI-assisted code review that uncovered 8 issues ranging from high to low severity, including unimplemented NFT claim flows, missing routes, and type safety bypasses in critical wallet paths. The AI not only found these issues but provided actionable recommendations with specific file references and line numbers.

3. Implementation Planning

AI helped me create a detailed 20-step implementation plan covering MVP through production hardening. The plan includes specific verification checklists for each step, making it easy to track progress and ensure nothing is missed.

4. Documentation Generation

The Phantom wallet setup guide was largely generated by AI, with step-by-step instructions for connecting the wallet using Brave browser. The AI anticipated common troubleshooting scenarios and included solutions.
